press_references.value: Apple @ Work: Parallels Desktop 27 brings OpenGL 4.3 and AI acceleration to Apple Silicon

product_launches.description: Parallels Desktop 27 is a virtualization software release for running Windows and Linux virtual machines on Apple Silicon Macs. It adds a Metal-based graphics driver, OpenGL 4.3 support, SME2-enabled AI acceleration, and enterprise deployment features.

press_references.value: Parallels RAS Expands Virtual Desktop Flexibility with New Hypervisor-Agnostic Custom Provider Framework

product_launches.description: Parallels launched Parallels RAS version 21.2, adding a new hypervisor-agnostic Custom Provider Framework, expanded Nutanix, Azure, and Azure Virtual Desktop integrations, and multiple security and user-experience enhancements across its clients and web gateway.

press_references.value: Parallels Confirms MacBook Neo Can Run Windows in a Virtual Machine

product_launches.description: Parallels confirmed that its Parallels Desktop virtualization software installs and runs stable virtual machines on Apple’s new MacBook Neo, though performance is recommended only for light Windows use due to the laptop’s 8GB RAM limit.

product_launches.description: Parallels released Desktop version 20.3, which improves Windows legacy app performance on M4 Macs and adds new USB device support for macOS VMs.

product_launches.description: Parallels Desktop for Mac version 20.1 introduces Apple Writing Tools to Windows virtual machines, enhancing text editing capabilities.

about_short_description.short_description: Parallels is an application for Mac that allows users to run Windows, Linux, operating systems, and applications

product.name: Parallels Desktop for Mac
product.description: Virtualization software that runs Windows, Linux, and other supported operating systems and applications on Intel- and Apple silicon-based Macs.

product.name: Parallels RAS (Remote Application Server)
product.description: An application and desktop delivery platform for publishing virtual applications and desktops to remote users from on-premises, cloud, or hybrid environments.

product.name: Parallels Secure Workspace
product.description: A browser-based secure workspace for remote access to applications, desktops, and files from supported devices.

product.name: Parallels DaaS
product.description: A cloud-based desktop and application delivery service that streams virtual applications and desktops to users over the internet.

product.name: Parallels Browser Isolation
product.description: A browser isolation solution that separates web sessions from endpoint devices to provide controlled access to web, SaaS, and cloud applications.

product.name: Parallels Toolbox
product.description: A collection of utility tools for common desktop tasks such as screen capture, recording, storage cleanup, and multimedia handling.
